name: @nipe-solutions/react-spring-bottom-sheet
description: Accessible and composable bottom sheets for React
author: Cody Olsen

scripts.build:dist: npm run clean && vite build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-styles.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build:dist && npm run test:package
